reviews.review: OK a lot to unpack here, i love the atmosphere, very unsettling but the map also feels empty. i get for optimization there cant be a lot of structures. as for the VR, it definitely needs a rework, the guns feel weird. you cant hold the shotgun correctly when you do you end up re-racking the gun and losing a shell, they should use the grip buttons for grip and pressing the triggers for things on the gun like charging handle and slide, and the actual trigger on the hand holding it. i also died  by an alien i think because i couldn't see what was attaching me. other then those things as long as they fix it quick it can be a  really neat game.

reviews.review:
Wouldn't buy in its current state if you intend on playing VR. Couldn't get multiplayer to work. My friend would connect and I could hear his voice in game for a second but then he wouldn't be there. Wouldn't show in the player list either. Also when setting a password for online you have to do it from the desktop version then close out and launch from VR, pretty tedious, early access isnt an excuse for leaving out basic UI for VR either IMO. Gunplay is just clunky and horrendous. Needs way more work before asking for people to pay for this game, even as an early access.
Desktop might be okay I didn't try that much but VR is a no go.
The game is definitely a work in progress really hard to play on index when my hands dont align to the actual location and the controls become very clunky to make stuff work with index controllers
